items.t: 'Healthy and fun': City of St. Augustine to launch new bikeshare program
items.x: The program will see 90 bicycles, 80 pedal and 10 pedal-assisted, distributed across St. Augustine.

items.t: Trump's cure for Republicans' midterm woes is more Trump. Will it work?
items.x: President Donald Trump wants midterm voters to imagine he's on the ballot and has seized the political spotlight in a way that makes such make-believe seem a bit more real.

items.t: Cyclone Arnab hits India's Andhra Pradesh state as tens of thousands evacuate
items.x: Officials say Cyclone Arnab crossed India’s Andhra Pradesh coast in the early hours of Wednesday, a day after tens of thousands of people were forced to evacuate from vulnerable coastal areas in the eastern state.

items.t: Asian stocks rise after a rally on Wall Street, while oil prices edge higher
items.x: Asian stocks are mostly higher as AI-related stocks boost benchmarks in Tokyo and Seoul ahead of quarterly earnings.

items.t: Jacksonville City Council approves loan for affordable housing project but debates funding source
items.x: Jacksonville City Council voted on a $2.8 million loan for the Tori Meadows affordable housing project, igniting debate over priorities for the city's housing fund.

items.t: Brewers' Aaron Ashby breaks postseason scoreless relief record as World Series Game 4 goes to extras
items.x: Milwaukee Brewers left-hander Aaron Ashby broke Andrew Miller’s record for scoreless innings by a reliever in one postseason with a 1-2-3 ninth in Game 4 of the World Series on Tuesday night.

items.t: Mom remembers son killed in downtown Jacksonville shooting as months go by without an arrest
items.x: Hayden Chalmers died after being shot at a bus stop on West Forsyth Street in downtown Jacksonville on Aug. 21. No arrests have been made.

items.t: Did anyone win the Mega Millions $443M jackpot? Here are the winning numbers for Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026
items.x: The Mega Millions jackpot has grown to $443 million after a ticket sold in Florida won a massive $803 million prize in July.

items.t: Iran hasn't tried to repair nuclear facilities damaged in US strikes, UN nuclear chief says
items.x: The head of the U.N. nuclear agency says there's been no indication Iran has tried to repair or reconstruct its nuclear facilities damaged in U.S. and Israeli military strikes this year or last year.

items.t: Jacksonville City Council reappoints General Joe DiSalvo to JEA board after months-long freeze
items.x: The Jacksonville City Council voted Tuesday to reappoint General Joe DiSalvo to the JEA board, ending a months-long freeze on board appointments that had been tied to investigations into toxic workplace allegations at the utility.

items.t: From stranger danger lessons to candy checks: Halloween safety tips for families
items.x: Planning routes around potential threats and scheduling check-in times on Halloween can help prevent scares.

items.t: Truck stolen by escaped Tennessee murderer found in Illinois, investigators say
items.x: Authorities say an escaped Tennessee inmate convicted of murder stole a truck from a nearby farm and apparently made it to southern Illinois before abandoning it.

items.x: An uptick in vacation requests signals an unofficial holiday for gamers as the much-anticipated release of "Grand Theft Auto VI" nears.
